question: Can a small locally replayed relation algebra recover nonzero strict coverage on P5K real pairs without conflicting with any observed counterexample?

allowed_lemmas.identity_composition_v0: A locally verified effect-free Identity commutes with a supported total operator on the bound domain.
allowed_lemmas.pointwise_channel_map_spatial_index_v0: A deterministic spatially pointwise channel map commutes with a value-preserving spatial index map or no-padding spatial selection whose parameters depend only on spatial shape and RNG independent of the pointwise map.

hypotheses.h1_coverage: Exactly 10 of P5K's 14 global Unknown pairs receive locally replayed Supported receipts; overall strict coverage is 10/28.
hypotheses.h2_no_conflict: Zero of P5K's 14 counterexample pairs receive a Supported receipt.
hypotheses.h3_unknown_preservation: The four remaining no-counterexample pairs (normalize-resize, resize-random_hflip, gaussian_blur-normalize, to_uint8-resize) remain Unknown.
hypotheses.h4_binding: Framework tree, verifier closure/version, input-domain, operator type/config, SourceIndex, lemma/artifact and duplicate tampering fail closed.
hypotheses.h5_schema: Every emitted receipt validates against the public V2 schema.
hypotheses.h6_backend: Identity/Normalize/CenterCrop obtain three pair receipts, restore six cedar candidates, trigger a reordered real-operator plan, and preserve output against the fixed baseline.

stop_rule: If verified coverage is below 30% of P5K Unknown pairs or any counterexample conflict occurs, stop automatic relation-producer expansion and retain only the external proof-carrying gate.
pass_rule: All six hypotheses hold on the frozen P5K corpus and fixed cedar commit; no excluded semantic family is silently admitted.
claim_boundary: Known contaminated torchvision mechanism calibration, not an independent commutativity oracle, formal proof of torchvision, or cross-version guarantee.
